about: Five optional stylised looks; Realistic is the engine default with no look and is offered by creation.json, not as a preset here. Each style has one plain slug, one preset, a UI pack, an art direction and frame checks. Views select how a look is drawn, never a variant or another style: cartoon covers 2D and cel-shaded 3D, anime covers side-view 2D and cel-shaded 3D, pixel covers side-view and top-down 2D. A game's file.look extends ["<slug>"]. No retired slugs or variants are aliases. preview is the engine-rendered 960x540 previews/<slug>.webp relative to knowledge/. look.layers names frame, conform, runtime and authored requirements; support is content when authored art is needed, full when all other layers are implemented, partial otherwise. look.views lists only views the style draws. look.mood is the preset's mood; games may select any of the six base moods. checks and intended are read by the critic; intended describes deliberate traits without naming the style. The descriptions are original, not imitations of games or studios.
artBibleTemplate: Art bible for {title}. Premise: {premise}. Camera: {camera}; platform and display size: {platform}. Style: {name} ({descriptor}) Direction: {direction} Palette: {palette}. Asset specs: {assets}. UI: the {ui} style the preset names (a ui field in the game's look picks another, or the game's own theme), re-coloured to this palette. Avoid: {avoid}. Proof: og-project.json selects the game's look as {look}, extending "{slug}"; capture the title, play and results screens with og run in the selected view and check each against: {checks}. Every later asset is made inside this bible; a request for one asset never redesigns the style.

styles.name: Low-poly
styles.descriptor: Simple chunky models, visible planar facets and clean toy-bright material colours; soft contact shadows anchor every piece without blurring the playfield.
checks: Broad flat-shaded facets remain visible on round forms and silhouettes are readable at play distance.
Each piece carries clean local colour rather than detailed photographic texture; small bevels catch the light without smoothing away the facets.
Soft contact shadows ground the pieces, while distant layers lose contrast and the whole playfield stays sharp.
styles.intended: Hard edges between broad planes, simplified chunky proportions and clean material colour are the style, not missing normals, missing detail or missing textures.

palette.rules: One clean colour per material; saturated accents and warm light, cooler quieter distance.

assets.textureDensity: flat colour or one palette texture

artBible.direction: Combine economical planar silhouettes with the tactile clarity of toy pieces: broad facets, tiny edge highlights, bright local colour and soft contact shadows. Keep every playable surface sharp.
avoid: smooth high-poly forms that hide facets

styles.name: Cartoon
styles.descriptor: Clean exaggerated shapes with warm dark contours and two or three flat tones per material: illustrated sprites in 2D, cel-shaded outlined models in 3D.
checks: Each material reads as two or three broad tones, without photographic texture or airbrushed gradients.
Figures and props keep a clean warm dark contour; in 3D the line follows silhouettes and major creases without covering the fills.
Exaggerated silhouettes and saturated characters read immediately against quieter layered backgrounds.
styles.intended: Flat stepped fills, warm dark contours and simple exaggerated proportions are the style, not banding, halos or missing surface detail.

missing: 2D illustration is authored content; conformance cannot invent characters or backdrops

authored.what: in 2D, a clean cartoon drawing with exaggerated shapes, two or three flat tones and a warm dark contour; in 3D, an expressive model with broad clean cel-shaded forms
simple layered colour planes, lighter and less contrasted than the characters, composed for the selected side or top-down view

palette.rules: Three tones per material; saturated characters, softer backgrounds; contours dark warm brown.

assets.textureDensity: 2D illustrations at 1x; 3D flat-colour or lightly drawn textures

artBible.direction: One cartoon language across drawings and volumes: clean flat fills, warm contours, expressive exaggerated silhouettes and readable staging. Retain the comic's strong crease accents, not its gritty hatching or print noise.

styles.name: Anime
styles.descriptor: Expressive drawn characters and clean cel bands with cool violet shadows, delicate dark contours and luminous skies; side-view illustration in 2D and cel-shaded volumes in 3D.
checks: Characters have clean silhouettes, expressive faces and two decisive shadow tones rather than photographic gradients.
Cool violet shadows preserve the local colour, and fine dark contours thin with distance in 3D.
The characters stay crisp and more contrasted than the layered atmospheric background; bright accents never erase faces or line work.
styles.intended: Hard shadow bands, cool-tinted shade and fine drawn contours are the style, not lighting discontinuities, colour casts or outline artefacts.

missing: 2D characters and backgrounds are authored illustration, not a post-process

authored.what: an expressive side-view animation drawing, precise fine contour, two cel tones, cool violet shade and a clear pose; for 3D use smooth volumes designed for clean cel bands
a side-view painted animation background with luminous sky and quiet layered distance, clear staging behind the character

palette.rules: Two decisive tones per material, cool indigo shadows, warm light and restrained luminous accents.

assets.textureDensity: flat or lightly painted, up to 2048 texels

artBible.direction: Precise animation drawing and expressive silhouettes, cool-tinted cel shadows, restrained fine contours and layered luminous scenery. Draw side-view sprites as illustration; build 3D characters for clean shadow bands.

styles.name: Pixel
styles.descriptor: Crisp sprites and tiles with stepped colour ramps on a strict pixel grid, drawn from the side with parallax or from above with upright y-sorted figures and readable paths.
checks: Sprite shading steps through four to six tones per material and edges stay on one logical pixel grid.
In side view the background layers separate from the playfield; from above, floor, cliff faces and paths read before decoration.
Tile seams have no gaps or bleeding and top-down figures overlap by their feet, with no mixed-resolution edges.
styles.intended: Hard single-cell steps, repeating tiles, stepped colour ramps and upright figures on an overhead map are the style, not aliasing, tiling errors or perspective mistakes.

premise.genre: platformer, action RPG, tactics, farming, overhead adventure

palette.rules: Four to six tone ramps; cool shadows and warm highlights; characters saturated, paths and floors quieter.

assets.outlinePx: 1 dark logical pixel, selectively broken by light

artBible.direction: A single strict grid in both views: stepped volume, strong playable silhouettes, layered side-view parallax or overhead paths with upright characters sorted by their feet. The view is a camera and drawing choice, not a variant.

styles.name: Neon
styles.descriptor: Luminous vector lines, grids and bright particles on dark fields; colour-coded silhouettes and restrained halos keep every shape legible.
checks: Thin bright contours and grids describe the playable shapes against a near-black field without losing their silhouettes.
A halo surrounds each bright line but leaves nearby lines and coloured parts distinguishable.
The geometry reads as luminous line work rather than filled shaded surfaces; distinct hues communicate player, hazard and reward.
styles.intended: Near-black fields, bright thin lines, luminous halos and unfilled geometry are the style, not underexposure, missing surfaces or an absent backdrop.

missing: line art is authored content: 2D luminous contours or 3D near-black faces with saturated emissive edges

authored.what: line art: black interiors, one saturated emissive hue per part and clean readable contours
a recognisable luminous silhouette with black interior, one outline hue and one accent, no shaded textures

palette.rules: One meaning per hue; white only at the hottest tiny centres.

artBible.direction: Luminous lines on black, grids for space, controlled particle accents and bloom that never obscures the line work.
